scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@taskflow/shared && npm run build --workspace=@taskflow/api && npm run build --workspace=@taskflow/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@taskflow/shared && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
